counting: independent operation variants; selected task/body/scene settings; no Cartesian product

design.zh: 直径 200 mm、厚 12 mm、质量 120 g；两面平整、质量均匀。
design.en: 200 mm diameter, 12 mm thick, 120 g; flat faces and uniform mass.

design.zh: 浅凹盘面、薄外沿、底部支撑圈；明确盘沿下方净空与倒扣支撑面。开发几何为外径 200 mm、总高 20 mm、120 g；14 mm 沿下净空，正放／倒扣静态支撑探针已通过。
design.en: Shallow concavity, thin rim and underside support ring; specify under-rim clearance and inverted support. Development geometry: 200 mm diameter, 20 mm total height, 120 g, 14 mm under-rim clearance. Upright/inverted static support probes passed.

design.zh: 复用 P2 几何，增加局部接触载荷限制；首版固定摩擦与质量，保留安全可行抓法。刚体损伤代理，不模拟真实破碎。
design.en: Reuse P2 geometry with local contact-load limits. Initially fix friction and mass and retain a feasible safe grasp. Rigid-body damage proxy, not physical fracture.

mechanism.zh: 推到桌边、双手夹持翻面、放回并释放；保留原协议。
mechanism.en: Push to the edge, flip under bimanual grasp, place and release; preserve the original protocol.

name.zh: 带沿浅盘：三指抓取适配

mechanism.zh: 根据盘沿净空与手指几何，选择夹沿、托底或上下夹持。
mechanism.en: Choose rim pinching, underside support or opposing-face grasp from rim clearance and finger geometry.

name.zh: 带沿浅盘：五指抓取适配

mechanism.zh: 与 DF-02-G 同场景，只更换手及必要控制映射；检验抓取策略是否改变。
mechanism.en: Same world as DF-02-G; change only the hand and required control mapping, testing whether grasp strategy changes.

mechanism.zh: 在抗滑与局部载荷限制之间选择安全抓法，必要时分担载荷或利用桌面。
mechanism.en: Balance slip resistance and local load limits; distribute load or use table support when needed.

mechanism.zh: 自主选择单／双手抓持、重抓与支撑交接，不强制沿用原版动作顺序。
mechanism.en: Choose one/two-hand grasp, regrasp and support transfer without the original mandatory sequence.

mechanism.zh: 与 DF-04-G 同物体、同桌面；按单臂与腕部能力选择完整翻面及释放策略。
mechanism.en: Same object and table as DF-04-G; adapt the complete flip and release to one arm and its wrist.
